text:
Incident Bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert fired: PD#RD-4821 - private-vpc-controlplane-unreachable. Trigger: healthcheck failure from customer 'AcmePayments' private control plane (vpc-prod-us-west-2).

PagerDuty: Incident created: https://pd.example.com/incidents/RD-4821 (linked). Escalation policy: private-vpc-oncall -> platform-sre -> eng-lead.

Jamie K.: acked on-call (private-vpc-oncall). I'm pulling logs now. Anyone on SRE shift with network access?

Priya R.: I'm online. I'll open the VPC console and check peering and route tables. Jamie, can you get the control-plane agent logs?

Mauro G.: tagging in - I have an SSH tunnel to the customer's bastion. If we need a restart of the on-prem agent, I can do it but want to confirm impact first.

Jamie K.: copying commands here. From our control plane side:
```
# check agent heartbeat from control plane
curl -s https://controlplane-api.internal/customers/acme/agents/agent-7/health | jq .
# expected: {"status":"ok","kv_cache":...}
```
Output: `{"status":"unreachable","last_seen":"2026-03-14T02:12:03Z"}`.

Jamie K.: From the agent side via bastion:
```
ssh ubuntu@bastion.acme-prod
ssh -A ubuntu@10.10.3.12 # agent host
sudo journalctl -u redwood-agent -n 200
```
Logs show repeated TLS handshake timeouts to controlplane.redwood.net and `x509: certificate is valid for controlplane.internal, not controlplane.redwood.net` errors.

Priya R.: That x509 mismatch suggests cert rotation happened on our side or the customer's DNS got mapped differently. I'm seeing an expired cert on the control plane CA in our cert manager history around `2026-03-14T01:58Z`. Rolling back to the previous CA now.

Incident Bot: :hourglass_flowing_sand: Escalation triggered: platform-sre pager on call (Mauro G.) - not yet acknowledged.

Mauro G.: acking platform-sre. I can take lead for the mitigation. Quick customer impact note: control plane outage prevents customer from managing private deployments; inference traffic continues to local agent if it's healthy, but control-plane initiated rollouts and metrics are affected. We should notify Support.

Support Bot: Notifying Support queue and creating status page draft: https://status.example.com/incidents/rd-4821-draft

Ellie S.: I'll join to help with communications. Jamie, any immediate mitigation while Priya rolls back the CA? Can we force the agent to accept the old cert fingerprint?

Jamie K.: Two options: 1) trigger agent restart after CA rollback (low risk), 2) temporarily configure control plane to accept both certs (requires deploy). Prefer rollback + restart.

Priya R.: CA rollback in control plane started: deploy id=ops-rollback-623. ETA ~ 90s to apply certs. Monitoring certs now.

Mauro G.: On bastion, I can validate agent TLS handshake after rollback. Command to test from agent host:
```
openssl s_client -connect controlplane.redwood.net:443 -servername controlplane.redwood.net -showcerts
```

Mauro G.: After rollback, openssl shows cert chain with CN=controlplane.redwood.net and valid dates. Good.

Jamie K.: Proceeding to restart agent on 10.10.3.12: `sudo systemctl restart redwood-agent`

Support Bot: Reaction :white_check_mark: - Restart initiated.

Mauro G.: Post-restart agent health report: `{"status":"ok","last_seen":"2026-03-14T02:15:21Z","version":"1.14.2"}`. Control plane connection stable.

Jamie K.: Confirmed from control plane: agent status GREEN, heartbeats restored. Moving incident state to 'mitigated' in PD and adding notes.

PagerDuty: Incident RD-4821 status changed to Acknowledged -> Resolved by Jamie K. Comments: Rollback of CA + agent restart restored connectivity.

Ellie S.: Drafted customer-facing note: "We experienced a control plane certificate rotation that briefly disrupted connectivity between the customer's private agent and Redwood control plane, impacting control-plane operations (no inference traffic loss reported). We rolled back the cert and restarted the agent; full connectivity restored at 02:15 UTC. Next steps: root cause RCA and long-lived cert rotation validation." @Support to review and send.

Support Bot: Customer notification queued to send after review.

Jamie K.: Action items assigned: [Priya] verify cert automation test coverage and prevent blind rotation; [Mauro] add an agent fallback to accept last-known-good CA for 5 minutes during rotations; [Ellie] publish customer note and postmortem summary. Creating follow-up ticket: https://tickets.example.com/issue/RD-4821-rca

Priya R.: Logging postmortem entry. Early note: unattended cert rotation triggered by expired intermediate in our staging-to-prod promotion job. We'll add an automatic validation step and a canary flag.

Mauro G.: Will prepare a short mitigation PR for agent fallback and include unit tests.

Jamie K.: Thanks all. I'll close the Slack thread once PD resolved and postmortem link added. :thumbsup:

Incident Bot: This thread will be archived to the incident log. PD Incidents: RD-4821 resolved.
